description: Eight independent switches, each working out for itself whether it is a two-to-one switch, a one-to-two router, a signal swapper, a mute, a flip flop or a toggled gate

params.text: Chooses whether that row's TRG jack is read as triggers that flip the switch each time, or as a gate that holds it over
Sets how long that row's crossfade between the two states takes, 1ms to 10 seconds; fully anticlockwise the change is instant

inputs.text: Flips that row's switch: one trigger to flip and the next to flip back in Toggle mode, or held above 1V in Gate mode
A trigger here returns that row's switch to its resting state
One of the two signals on that row, or the one signal being routed
The second signal on that row, or the second source being swapped

outputs.text: That row's switched, routed or swapped signal
That row's second destination, or the inverse of its OUT 1 when the row is acting as a flip flop

notes: each row reads its function off the cables in its own jacks: two inputs and one output make a switch, one input and two outputs make a router.
two inputs and two outputs make a swapper, one input and one output a mute, two outputs alone a flip flop, and one output alone a toggled gate.
there is no fade CV jack on this version; each row's fade comes from its FD knob alone.
menu: Initialize on Start — comes up with every row in its resting state when Rack loads a patch, instead of resuming the saved states
